# Access AI QA

> Get started with Retell AI QA: open the AI QA tab from the sidebar and click Create QA to launch your first automated call quality evaluation.

To get started, click the **AI Quality Assurance** tab in the left sidebar. This opens the AI QA dashboard, where you can view existing cohorts or create new ones.

<Frame caption="The AI QA tab in the left sidebar.">
  <img style={{ width: '200px', height: 'auto' }} src="https://mintcdn.com/retellai/2TMI5ueo5Rw-kjFw/ai-qa/images/advanced-qa-tab.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=2TMI5ueo5Rw-kjFw&q=85&s=122a0ab8ce9d2ab0d0b9d7c3a18f7cdb" alt="AI QA tab highlighted in the Retell left sidebar navigation" width="552" height="1376" data-path="ai-qa/images/advanced-qa-tab.png" />
</Frame>

To start a new evaluation, click the **Create QA** button at the top right of the AI QA page.

<Frame caption="Click Create QA to start a new cohort.">
  <img height="700" src="https://mintcdn.com/retellai/6wkwFDKypdjHQ-22/ai-qa/images/create-qa-button.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=6wkwFDKypdjHQ-22&q=85&s=39fa03aeb10eafb7080443c50f04e60e" alt="AI QA dashboard with the Create QA button highlighted at the top right" data-path="ai-qa/images/create-qa-button.png" />
</Frame>

This opens the Create QA flow. Continue with [Define a QA cohort](/ai-qa/create-cohort) to choose which calls to evaluate.
